Dataset S1: List of S-Chimeras from Exp. Phase and Stat. Phase RIL-seq libraries with greather than 32 (Exp. Phase) and 27 (Stat. Phase)
Notes:
1. rRNA are excluded from the tables
2. RNA1/RNA2  refers to the first/second RNA in the chimeric fragments
3. S-chimeras that appear to arise from a single transcript are listed in the pages labelled "Self S-Chimeras".
Number: S-chimera rank in terms of total chimeric fragments/interactions detected
RNA1 name: based on the genomic location RNA1 was mapped to
RNA2 name: based on the genomic location RNA2 was mapped to
RNA1 chromosome: Chromosome the RNA1 was mapped to.
RNA1 from: The coordinate where the first nucleotide of the first (most 5’) read corresponding to RNA1 was mapped to.
RNA1 to: The coordinate where the first nucleotide of the last (most 3’) read corresponding to RNA1 was mapped to.
RNA1 Strand: The strand RNA1 was mapped to.
RNA1 Gene: locus tag based on genomic location of RNA1.
RNA2 chromosome: Chromosome RNA2 is mapped to.
RNA2 from: The coordinate where the last nucleotide of the first (most 5’) read corresponding to RNA2 was mapped to.
RNA2 to: The coordinate where the last nucleotide of the last (most 3’) read corresponding to RNA2 was mapped to.
RNA2 Strand: The strand RNA2 was mapped to.
RNA2 Gene: locus tag based on genomic location of RNA2.
Number of  interactions:   Number off chimeras supporting the interaction.
Other Interactions of RNA1: Number of other fragments in which RNA1 appears as first, including single fragments.
Other interactions of RNA2: Number of other sequenced fragments in which the second RNA appears as second, including single fragments.
Total other interactions: Number of sequenced fragments in the experiment excluding the above.
Odds Ratio: (K/L)/(M/N), where K= Number of interactions , L=other interactions of RNA2, M=other interactions of RNA1, N=total other interactions.
Fisher's exact test p-value: p-value for observing at least this number of chimeric fragments given their background frequencies on Hfq. The Odds Ratio provides the effect size of the test.
annotation class RNA1: transcript type (i.e., mRNA, sRNA, tRNA, etc.) for RNA1
annotation class RNA1: transcript type (i.e., mRNA, sRNA, tRNA, etc.) for RNA2
novel sRNA: Indicates if the RNAs (i.e., RNA1 or RNA2) is a putative novel sRNAs identified herein.
